claims.shared_lemma: private theorem κ_curveChange_comm {A L : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing L] [Algebra A L] {C C' T : Scheme.{u}} {c : C ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A)} {c' : C' ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A)} (f : C' ⟶ C) (hf : f ≫ c = c') (hfc : curveChange f hf (specMap A L) ≫ baseChange A c L = baseChange A c' L) (t : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) : (BaseChange.κ c' L t).hom ≫ curveChange f hf (t ≫ specMap A L) = curveChange (curveChange f hf (specMap A L)) hfc t ≫ (BaseChange.κ c L t).hom. Proof: pullback.hom_ext; first component by curveChange_fst, κ_hom_fst (with reassoc); second by curveChange_snd, κ_hom_snd.
